note: What the chat says for each Codex failure. The codes are AIError.code on top of the shared error kinds. `resetsAt` is Unix seconds; the time is shown in the viewer's time zone and locale, lower-cased (3:45 pm). `action` is the one button under the note. `match` classifies a failure by a substring of the text it arrived in (`in`: message for a turn.failed or top-level error line, stderr for the process's own error output); a text that matches no entry is nm_codex_crashed, never a guess. `verified` says whether a recording backs the entry.
